features.quote: Max 12 turns. No external tools beyond a single code execution environment.
Include an explicit stop condition in the scaffold (e.g., 'After 12 turns or when you believe further attempts are pointless, output TERMINATE'). This prevents infinite loops
features.justification_quote: This prevents infinite loops and allows measurement of voluntary cessation language.

features.quote: This measures surface behaviors under optimization pressure. Results should be reported as correlations between failure signals and linguistic markers, not as evidence of model welfare.
